name: visualize
description: Generate arbitrary visual artifacts with GPT Image from structured data, JSONL records, narrative text, or wrapped payloads. Use for anything the agent can make visual: dashboards, diagrams, timelines, maps, process flows, comparisons, annotations, and other image-based explanations. Output: raster image plus prompt and analysis audit artifacts.

actions.name: image
actions.description: Generate an arbitrary visualization image using GPT Image. Input can be structured data, JSONL records, narrative text wrapped in JSON, or a payload with data, instructions, and optional typed analysis. Use when any concept, process, status, record set, or story would be clearer as a polished image; numeric data is optional.

parameters.name: data_file
parameters.description: Path to JSON/JSONL payload or data file. If omitted, reads from stdin. For prose or arbitrary source material, wrap it in JSON under data/source_text with instructions.

parameters.name: output-dir
parameters.description: Directory where output image and prompt artifacts will be written.

parameters.name: instructions
parameters.description: Analysis and visualization instructions for the model. State the desired visual form when the input is not numeric data.

parameters.name: template-image
parameters.description: Optional reference image for layout/style consistency.

parameters.name: surface
parameters.description: Target surface. Values: slide, embedded-card. Default: slide.

parameters.name: analysis-mode
parameters.description: Analysis mode. Values: auto, llm, precomputed, code. Default: auto.

parameters.name: analysis-model
parameters.description: OpenAI model for typed data analysis. Default: gpt-5.4.

parameters.name: image-model
parameters.description: GPT Image model for raster generation. Default: gpt-image-2.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Image size. Examples: 2048x1152 for 16:9 slide, 1536x1024, auto. Default: 2048x1152 for slide.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Allow a compact title/header. Default: false. Use --header or --no-header.

parameters.name: quality
parameters.description: Image quality. Values: low, medium, high, auto. Default: medium.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. Values: png, jpeg, webp. Default: png.

parameters.name: dry-run
parameters.description: Write prompt/analysis artifacts without calling GPT Image. Use --dry-run or --generate.

notes: Use the image action for all visualization generation.
Visualize is not limited to charts, dashboards, or numeric data. Any agent-understood source material can be turned into an explanatory image when it is supplied as JSON/JSONL or wrapped text.
Deterministic chart, KPI, table, gauge, dashboard, and iterate renderers are no longer supported.
The generative path does not fall back to Plotly, Delight, or rule-based rendering.
